title: LOWRIDER//2099 v2 HOVER
description: Candidate 2. B's takeover from 0:00 (hook over dirty 808 and hard drums, Beast answers), then the hover spin-up: the Beast cable winds from countable pulses into F3 over two bars under a snare build, a hydraulic pssht and a gasp, and a slam into a half-time version of A's swung bounce with a talking 808 WOOOW, ending in a tape-stop dive. 10 bars, 96 BPM, F minor.

tracks.description: Whine lead: the call, octave whoop; out for the Beast and for the second half of the drop
Wobble Beast answers and the talking-808 drop
Hover spin-up (Beast cable, pulses to pitch over bars 5-6), hydraulic pssht, the slam
